title: Even Though...
grammar: Recap: annak ellenére, hogy; bár, habár, noha
goal: I can say what happened in spite of something, with annak ellenére, hogy and bár.
I can say where representatives meet, using -ban/-ben.
I can talk about parliament with four new words, such as országgyűlés and törvényjavaslat.
I can say who a képviselő is.
